name: mga
description: MGA — Multi-tenant web analytics (Collect → Queue → MSSQL API)

scripts.build: npm run build -w @mga/shared && npm run build -w @mga/sdk && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.predev: npm run build -w @mga/shared && npm run build -w @mga/sdk
scripts.dev: concurrently -n collector,writer,mock,query,dash -c blue,green,yellow,magenta,cyan "npm run dev -w @mga/collector" "npm run dev -w @mga/writer" "npm run dev -w @mga/mock-mssql-api" "npm run dev -w @mga/query-api" "npm run dev -w @mga/dashboard"
